info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Textile Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Textile Pendant Detail Management API allows users to effectively manage detailed information related to textile pendants within the catalog. This API enables the addition of new textile pendant details, which are essential for inventory management and product offerings. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and merchandise management systems that require detailed product specifications. Developers can integrate this API to streamline inventory processes and enhance product data accuracy.

post.summary: Create new details for a textile pendant.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and store detailed information about a specific textile pendant. You can provide various attributes and characteristics that define the textile pendant, which will be saved in the system for future reference. This operation supports managing your textile pendant collection effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating details of a textile pendant. The payload should contain the relevant attributes for the pendant, formatted as a JSON object.

200.description: The request was successful and the details of the textile pendant are returned.
